about_page.title: Software engineer in Lomé, from business need to production.
about_page.lead: I'm Kalvin Takoudjou. A full-stack developer and consultant at Myriade Groupe since 2024, I design web and mobile applications, from the database to the screen. I am also working towards an MBA in Big Data and Artificial Intelligence.

business.title: Start from the business
business.text: Employee time tracking, ticket sales, inventory, rentals: every project starts from the real process it has to serve, before any choice of tools.

system.title: One system, several screens
system.text: A mobile app in the field, a dashboard on the web, an API at the centre: the same data serves every screen.

delivery.title: Ship, not just build
delivery.text: Docker containers and deployment are part of the job: software is finished when it runs for the people who use it.

architecture.title: Make the architecture readable
architecture.text: Every project in this portfolio comes with its diagram — components, exchanges, stack — so that a client and a developer alike can see what was built.
